verdict.rationale: Conductor's docs describe a 'bring your own subscriptions and keys' model where users must sign in to their own Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor subscription or supply an API key (conductor-docs-19, conductor-docs-23, conductor-docs-7); there is no mention of a free tier accessible purely via personal account sign-in without managing credentials. Community discussion also focuses on GitHub OAuth/permissions issues, not a free-tier access model.
